module: Flowgraph node "EndScreen AI Competitors Leaderboard" (category once_instant, tags end/finish/rally): adds an AI competitors leaderboard tab to the mission end screen (rally). Inputs: flow (chaining), "leaderboard" (table from the Rally AI Competitors Leaderboard node). Single stage: time and gap columns; multi-stage: one column per stage plus the final. Adds a UI element 'textPanel' via self.mgr.modules.ui:addUIElement with header 'missions.aiCompetitorsLeaderboard.title'.
notes: Silently ignored if the table is empty; logs an error and ignores if the multi-stage structure is invalid (stageCount, stageLabels, stageCells).
The player name comes from OnlineServiceProvider.playerName, otherwise 'Player' (useDefaultPlayerName = true).

workOnce.desc: Validates the leaderboard data and adds the 'textPanel' panel to the end screen.
